name: Kubernetes Cluster MCP
shortDescription: Inspect Kubernetes pods, deployments, services, ingress, describe cluster events, and debug workloads.
longDescription: Interact with local and remote Kubernetes clusters. Query namespace resources, inspect deployment health, describe failed pods, fetch pod logs, and inspect CRDs.
author: fluxninja

tools.name: k8s_list_pods
tools.description: List pods in a specific namespace with status and restart counts.

tools.name: k8s_get_logs
tools.description: Fetch container logs for a pod.

tools.name: k8s_describe_resource
tools.description: Describe pod, deployment, or service with detailed events.

installSteps.title: Configure MCP
installSteps.description: Ensure your active kubeconfig context points to the desired cluster.
